ccpe.configuration.title: CC Peripheral Extender Config
ccpe.configuration.sensorNbtPollInterval: Sensor GUI auto-refresh interval in ticks (20 = 1 second). Set to 0 to disable.
ccpe.configuration.sensorChunkLoadEnable: Whether sensors can force-load the chunk they are in.
ccpe.configuration.sensorMaxForceLoad.to: Maximum number of sensors that can force-load chunks simultaneously. 0 = unlimited.
ccpe.configuration.sensorPortalTicketRad: PORTAL ticket radius in chunks for sensors on Sable physics structures. Each sensor loads (2×R+1)² chunks. Default: 3 (7×7 chunks).
ccpe.configuration.servoStressImpact.too: Stress coefficient for the Transmission Peripheral in transmission mode. Actual stress = value × |output RPM − input RPM|.
ccpe.configuration.servoModeStressImpact: Stress coefficient for the Transmission Peripheral in servo mode. Actual stress = value × |real output RPM| (the output speed may be overridden/accelerated by setServoSpeed).
ccpe.configuration.flightDataRecorderEna: Log per-tick body data for every FMC/AIC/INS-registered aircraft into <gameDir>/flight_logs/*.csv (debug tool). Active while at least one FMC/AIC/INS sensor is on a Sable physics body (INS-only bodies get kinematics/velocity columns; physics columns read nan). Default OFF; enable only when you need to record a flight.
ccpe.configuration.flightDataRecorderInt: Flight data recorder sampling interval in ticks (1 = every tick / 20 Hz).
ccpe.configuration.monitorOutlineR.toolt: Monitor module outline color - Red (0-255). Default: 90
ccpe.configuration.monitorOutlineG.toolt: Monitor module outline color - Green (0-255). Default: 143
ccpe.configuration.monitorOutlineB.toolt: Monitor module outline color - Blue (0-255). Default: 60
ccpe.configuration.monitorOutlineA.toolt: Monitor module outline color - Alpha / opacity (0-255). Default: 255
Monitor checkerboard grid line thickness multiplier (0.0-2.0). Default: 1.0
ccpe.configuration.monitorOutlineLineWid: Monitor module outline / preview box line thickness multiplier (0.0-2.0). Default: 1.0
ccpe.configuration.joystickOverlayEnable: Show the virtual joystick HUD while operating from a seat (default off to keep immersion; enable in client config when needed).
ccpe.configuration.engineFluidPuffVolume: Volume of the piston 'puff' sound on fluid combustion chambers (0.0-2.0, 0 = disable this sound logic). Default: 0.05 (Create STEAM sound, once per piston cycle; rate tied to RPM).
ccpe.configuration.contrailEnabled.toolt: Master switch for the high-altitude contrail (the exhaust plume is unaffected)
ccpe.configuration.contrailLifeMax.toolt: MAIN PERFORMANCE LEVER: particle count ~ density x lifetime. Default: 1200 (60s)
ccpe.configuration.contrailSpacing.toolt: MAIN PERFORMANCE LEVER: one particle per this distance flown. Default: 1.2
ccpe.configuration.contrailMaxPerTick.to: Max particles spawned per tick. Default: 6
ccpe.configuration.contrailMaxLive.toolt: Hard cap on live contrail particles, 0 = unlimited. Default: 6000
ccpe.configuration.contrailMaxDistance.t: Stop emitting farther than this from the nearest player, 0 = unlimited. Default: 96
ccpe.configuration.contrailWidth.tooltip: Quad radius (visible width ~2x), grows by sqrt(t). Default: 1.0
ccpe.configuration.contrailWidthTau.tool: width = spawnWidth x sqrt(1 + age/tau). Rule of thumb: tau = lifetime/4. Default: 300
ccpe.configuration.contrailAlpha.tooltip: Spawn opacity (0-1), fades as the puff spreads. Default: 0.6
ccpe.configuration.contrailDriftDistance: Total distance a particle drifts over its life (speed = distance / lifetime). Default: 4.0
ccpe.configuration.exhaustParticlesPerTi: MAIN PERFORMANCE LEVER: particles per tick at 256 RPM. Default: 10
ccpe.configuration.exhaustSpeed.tooltip: Spawn speed, multiplied by (0.65 + 0.35 x throttle). Default: 2.0
ccpe.configuration.exhaustGravity.toolti: Slight gravity on the exhaust plume, 0 = weightless. Terminal fall speed scales with age (fastest right after leaving the nozzle). Default: 0.02
ccpe.configuration.exhaustMaxDistance.to: Stop emitting beyond this distance, 0 = unlimited. Default: 64
ccpe.configuration.intakeEnabled.tooltip: Air being sucked into the nozzle mouth when the fan runs in reverse (negative RPM = suction). Off = no particles while suctioning
ccpe.configuration.intakeParticlesPerTic: Performance knob: particles per tick at full speed (256 RPM), scaled by RPM. Default: 8
ccpe.configuration.intakeFunnelLength.to: Length at full speed (256 RPM), scaled linearly by RPM (128 RPM = half). Particles spawn within this range in front of the mouth, then accelerate into it. Default: 8.0
ccpe.configuration.intakeSpeed.tooltip: Lifetime = spawn distance / this value, so higher = faster and shorter-lived. Multiplied by (0.6 + 0.4 x throttle). Default: 0.5
ccpe.configuration.intakeScale.tooltip: Spawn size, shrinks to 0.3x over its lifetime. Default: 0.28
ccpe.configuration.intakeMaxDistance.too: Stop emitting beyond this distance from the nearest player, 0 = unlimited. Default: 64
ccpe.configuration.engineSteamPuffVolume: Volume of the piston 'puff' sound on steam power chambers (0.0-2.0, 0 = disable this sound logic). Default: 0.1 (Create STEAM sound, once per piston cycle; rate tied to RPM).
